title: 100 tiny charms, zero judgment
caption:
100 tiny charms. Zero of them judge you 🌿

In Daily Charm, new charms show up as you log your days: to-dos, habits, a mood, one line of diary. You open each one by tapping a little gift box.

Free to start on the App Store (iPhone). Search “Daily Charm”.

#todolist #habittracker #cozyapps #productivity #dailycharm

veo.prompt: Stop-motion style scene of three empty wooden shelves on a cream paper wall. Very subtle motion: soft sunlight slowly drifts across the wall and tiny dust motes float in the light. Nothing new appears: no characters, no animals, no people, no objects are added, and nothing moves from its place. Locked-off static camera, no zoom, soft warm even light, calm and cozy.

scenes.small: They show up as you log your day.
